notes.title: I'll be Brave, Tomorrow - Developer Playthrough - GIVING MONEY TO CHARITY?
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2741070/Ill_be_Brave_Tomorrow__Narrative_Platformer_for_Charity/
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2741070/Ill_be_Brave_Tomorrow__Narrative_Platformer_for_Charity/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831101/4991ebd7d314b5ba851f9d428bd8f85c03283fcc.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://discord.gg/JUDnzKGHE9][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831101/ebe3e8533f1904faa929c1feb0389b255ba5f842.png[/img][/url]

[list][*] An[b] adventure driven narrative experience[/b][/list]
[list][*] [b]Precise pixel art platforming[/b] inspired by the 80's[/list]
[list][*] Fun replayable [b]minigames[/b][/list]
[list][*] A [b]deep narrative[/b] revolving around a sick child[/list]
[list][*][b] 50% of revenue[/b] goes to [b]Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity[/b][/list]
The game itself has two aspects; [b]The 3D hospital room[/b], where there are many objects to interactive with, as well as mini-games to keep the kid entertained...

But there is also the video game they play, which is a[b] classic 2D retro platformer[/b]! The 3D world will interact with the 2D in various ways, from new mechanics found, to boss fights!

InkForge Studios are supporting the wonderful[b] Great Ormond Street Hospital (GOSH) Charity[/b], pledging to donate [b]50% of the games Steam revenue[/b]!
